answer: After a restart, events after the last checkpoint are replayed, so the sink receives the same window twice. Three options make the sink cope: (1) an upsert sink keyed by product and window start, so the latest emission overwrites the earlier row; (2) a transactional sink that commits output in the same transaction as the offsets, so uncommitted post-checkpoint writes never appear; (3) a dedupe view on the read side that keeps the latest row per key via ROW_NUMBER() ordered by emitted_at DESC. Prefer the upsert sink when the sink supports it, because the view adds a window function to every query and leaves orphan rows in the table.
